summary: Tested new PTO (Vacation/Holiday/Sick) settings per Medina County ESD1 Policy P-021. Backend: 4/4 pytest tests passed for GET /api/pto-settings, /api/pto-settings/rates-summary, PUT update+persistence, and unauthenticated blocking. All default values match policy exactly (vacation 60/96/144/168 ops, 40/80/120/140 admin, rollover 240/120, 6mo waiting; holiday 12/8 hrs, 11 count, 50% cashout, call-off penalty on; sick 48/72/96 ops, 40/64/80 admin, 1080 cap, allow_negative=false). Frontend: logged in as 100001/admin123, navigated to /tools/branding, verified 'Paid Time Off Policy Settings' section with 3 tabs (vacation/holiday/sick). All 20+ data-testid elements found with correct default values. Federal holidays list (Independence/Christmas/Thanksgiving/Labor Day/Memorial) rendered on Holiday tab. Sick tab shows 'CANNOT go negative' warning and Negative Balance NOT Allowed toggle in ON (blocking) state. Save button produced success toast 'Paid Time Off settings saved'.
critical_code_review_comments: pto_settings_routes.py PUT allows role 'battalion_chief' in addition to 'admin'—verify vs. policy intent (usually Admin-only).

PTOSettings pydantic model defines rates as empty lists by default; if a client PUTs without rates, saved settings will have empty rate tiers and calculate-accrual returns 0 hours. Consider populating defaults server-side on PUT if arrays are empty.
calculate-accrual uses hire_date fallback to created_at[:10]; if created_at is a datetime object (not str), slicing may raise. Safer to isoformat first.
Old HolidayAccrualSettings.js still exists alongside new PaidTimeOffSettings.js; consider removing dead code to avoid confusion.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PTO settings verified end-to-end. Backend regression at /app/backend/tests/test_pto_settings.py. All P-021 defaults confirmed. No functional bugs.
